_README: Schema for kaggle/songs.json -- the daily song spec the Kaggle kernel reads (INPUT_MODE='file'). The Claude routine OVERWRITES kaggle/songs.json each morning. This .example file is documentation only and is NOT read by the kernel. A day may be a single object (below), a bare list of objects, or {"songs": [ ... ]} for multiple songs.
title: Human-readable title; used only to name the output files.
prompt: REQUIRED. The caption/style description (genre, instruments, mood, vocals). Alias: 'caption'. This is the single most important field.
lyrics: REQUIRED. Structured lyrics with section tags, e.g. [verse]...\n[chorus]...  Use \n for line breaks.
vocal_language: Language hint, or 'unknown' to auto-detect from the lyrics.
_optional_overrides: Everything below is optional; omit to let the LM auto-infer. Field names match GenerateMusicRequest; convenience aliases are mapped in build_notebook.py:_build_request_body.

songs.title: Song A
songs.prompt: lofi hip hop, mellow, rainy night
